pose_sample_rule: after each mj_step with k >= settle_steps: cached xpos/xquat/xmat of the part body (pre-integration pose of that step), labelled task_time (k - settle_steps) * dt
qpos_state_rule: after mj_step with k >= settle_steps, record (task_time, qpos copy) when task_time >= len(states)/30 - 1e-9
schedule_semantics: ctrl row k is written to MjData.ctrl immediately before the k-th mj_step; row 0 is also the pre-settle ctrl
